newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Only three of 20 ships operating at Brazil Santos.
newsitem.headline: Only three of 20 ships operating at Brazil Santos.

text.p: Only three ships were operating out of a total of 20 docked at Brazil's key port of Santos due to a strike by stevedores, a port authority spokesman said.
Of the 20 ships docked, 16 were in public terminals. Two of these were operating loading liquid products, the spokesman said.
The other ship loading was in a private terminal, he added.
Exact details of cargoes of ships docked would be available later, he said.

Stevedores are striking because of a decision by a local steel firm to use its own workers at its private terminal at the port. The strike, which is for an indefinite period, could spread to a national level as of Wednesday.
